note: Superior NF campground on Two Island Lake (753 ac), about 15 mi northwest of Grand Marais off County Road 27, with a boat ramp; the loops sit in the woods back from the shore. The Eagle Mountain trailhead is 4 mi west. --Claude
summary: FS page read: 38 pull-in sites (not designed for RVs; most take a moderately sized vehicle), vault toilets, solar-faucet drinking water, $22 (second vehicle half fee), May 8-Oct 19; rec.gov holds only an info record, so first come. Season to the FS dates; booking confirmed FCFS; note rewritten. Not waterfront kept; pin confirmed.
flags: FIT: FS wording 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. Most can accommodate a moderately sized vehicle, some may not be suitable for an RV.' is the Superior NF's common sentence (p3-441 found the same sentence on other Superior NF pages, e.g. Whiteface Reservoir 5506), so no criteria flag; no length posted. The old note's 'most fit a 23-ft rig' was an inference and is dropped.

STATUS: the FS page shows 'Site Temporarily Closed / Closed-No fees or services' now, consistent with the season ending Oct 19; no status written. The post-wildfire closure order (09-09-00-26-11, Oct 1 2026-Apr 1 2027) covers BWCAW areas and the Echo Trail, not this campground.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: on Esri imagery the loops (centre ~47.8797,-90.4445) sit in continuous conifer forest, the nearest spurs 30-80 m from the shore through trees; the open patch by the lake at about 47.8800,-90.4454 is the boat-launch lot. No site photos.
PIN 47.87972,-90.44454 equals the FS point and sits between the two loops; confirmed. PHONE 218-387-1750 (Gunflint Ranger District) confirmed. WEBSITE confirmed.
